deathBeat: d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Lucas Pascual is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d34: 🕯️ Lucas Pascual is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d34: The village's quarrel was with Lucas — and Lucas is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d35: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hummice is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
recoverHome: d35: That night, they bring Lucas home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
vouch: d34: At the grave, Eli, Catalina speak for Masud — "Lucas trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
systemVoice: d35: SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
